scientific_question: Does the CALiSol-derived conductivity ranking fixed after the SolventSeg analysis improve low-label, temporally held-out candidate ordering in an independent LiPF6-EC-EMC experimental campaign?

claim_guard.positive: An unchanged cross-database donor ranking replicates on one additional experimental programme and improves retrospective OOD candidate prioritization.
claim_guard.null: The SolventSeg rank-transfer result does not replicate under the unchanged contract on this programme.
claim_guard.harm: The unchanged donor ranking is less concordant with held-out experimental outcomes than the strongest recipient-only baseline or a support-matched falsifier.
forbidden: confirmation by changing the donor model, anchors, split, metric, or practical gate after outcome access

recipient.name: FINALES electrolyte optimization for maximum conductivity and cycle life

primary_archive.filename: FINALES (11_2023) Electrolyte Optimization for Maximum Conductivity and for Maximum Cycle Life.zip

secondary_archive.filename: FINALES (09_2023) Electrolyte Optimization for Maximum Conductivity and for Maximum Cycle Life.zip

recipient.eligible_rows: valid experimental ASAB conductivity results only; molecular-dynamics, calibration-only, failed, pending, low-quality, and non-conductivity records are excluded
recipient.candidate_unit: unique reported LiPF6-EC-EMC formulation within phase

donor.name: CALiSol-23 LiPF6-EC-EMC subset used in the independently reproduced SolventSeg analysis

split.ordering: chronological by recipient result timestamp, with request timestamp as the deterministic tie breaker
split.anchors: the first three distinct eligible experimental formulations in the primary phase
split.evaluation: all later unique eligible experimental formulations in the primary phase
split.hard_ood_scope: the 40% of evaluation formulations farthest from the three anchors in standardized composition space; standardization is fitted on all outcome-free recipient compositions
split.secondary_scope: repeat the unchanged rule in the single-task phase without pooling phases
prohibited: choosing a favorable temperature subset after outcome access
moving repeated formulations across anchor and evaluation sets

recipient_only: ExtraTreesRegressor trained on the three anchor formulations with fixed random_state 2025
HistGradientBoostingRegressor trained on the same anchors with fixed random_state 2025
linear composition-temperature model trained on the same anchors
falsifiers: 2000 global permutations of the 410 CALiSol donor labels
a deterministic size- and support-matched non-LiPF6 carbonate-electrolyte donor from CALiSol-23 if at least 205 eligible rows exist
comparators.strong_baseline_rule: the recipient-only comparator with the highest primary metric is used in the donor-minus-baseline contrast; all comparator results remain reported

primary.name: temperature-matched pairwise concordance advantage
primary.definition: Among held-out formulation pairs measured within 1 degree C, compute the fraction whose predicted ordering agrees with measured conductivity ordering; subtract the strongest recipient-only baseline.
primary.fallback_without_outcome_tuning: If fewer than 50 eligible held-out pairs exist, widen the temperature tolerance once to 2 degree C; if fewer than 50 pairs remain, declare the primary test ineligible.

secondary: within-temperature-bin mean Spearman rho using prespecified 2 degree C bins
pooled Spearman rho, disclosed as temperature-confounded
normalized regret of the top-ranked candidate within temperature bins
hard-OOD versions of the primary and secondary metrics

inference.primary_test: one-sided formulation-cluster bootstrap interval for donor-minus-strong-baseline concordance
inference.multiplicity: The primary multitask-phase concordance contrast is the sole confirmatory test. All other scopes and metrics are secondary.

all_required: recipient and donor archive hashes match
no exact recipient formulation or recipient DOI appears in the donor source records
95% formulation-cluster bootstrap interval is above zero
empirical donor-label permutation p is at most 0.05
donor top-quartile precision exceeds the strongest recipient-only baseline
donor normalized regret is lower than the strongest recipient-only baseline
the real donor exceeds the support-matched wrong donor when that falsifier is eligible
success_gate.abstention: Any failed required gate prevents a replication claim. Ineligible primary comparison is reported as ineligible, not replaced.

post_outcome_change_policy: Corrections needed only to parse the published schema may be documented in an amendment before model fitting. Any change to donor, anchors, split, transferred object, primary metric, or gate creates a new exploratory analysis and cannot alter the frozen result.
